events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Impact and legacy
angles.copy: Today marks 30 years since the tragic passing of Tupac Shakur. His music and message continue to resonate, cementing his place as a hip-hop legend.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: A Legacy Remembered
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix in 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure timeless magic. Which is your favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Today, The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her fierce talent and distinctive voice have fronted The Pretenders for decades. Rock on!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, his iconic swagger and voice remain unmistakable. What's your top track?

events.title: Imagine Released 51 Years Ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Anthem
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with hope and peace around the world. What does it mean to you?

events.title: The iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: The first-generation Apple iPod, which revolutionised how we listen to music, was released on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Tech Game Changer
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago today, the original iPod dropped and changed music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab a martini (shaken, not stirred) – it's James Bond Day! Celebrating the enduring legacy of 007. Who's your favourite Bond and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' co-founder and peace activist John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Today, the legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly unmatched. What's your favourite moment?

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, universally known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Diverse Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that showed every facet of their genius. What's your hidden gem from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only Freddie Mercury. His unparalleled stage presence and incredible voice continue to captivate millions. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Game Changer
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed musical boundaries and influenced countless artists. A true gem!

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world tragically lost music icon John Lennon, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of John Lennon's passing. His powerful voice for peace and his timeless music live on, inspiring us all.
